sentences.text: John Roy `` Johnny '' Van Zant -LRB- born February 27 , 1959 -RRB- is an American musician and the current lead vocalist of Southern rock band Lynyrd Skynyrd .	Southern rock	Southern rock	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Van Zant	Van Zant

He is the younger brother of the late Lynyrd Skynyrd co-founder and former lead vocalist Ronnie Van Zant , and of the .38 Special founder , Donnie Van Zant .	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Van Zant	Van Zant	Ronnie Van Zant	Ronnie Van Zant	Donnie Van Zant	Donnie Van Zant
Van Zant performed during the 1970s with his first band , The Austin Nickels Band .	Van Zant	Van Zant

They later changed their name to The Johnny Van Zant Band releasing their debut solo album , No More Dirty Deals , in 1980 .	The Johnny Van Zant Band	The Johnny Van Zant Band	Van Zant	Van Zant	No More Dirty Deals	No More Dirty Deals

Original members of The Johnny Van Zant Band consisted of Van Zant on lead vocals , Robbie Gay on guitar , Danny Clausman , on bass , Erik Lundgren on lead guitar , Robbie Morris , drums and Joan Hecht -LRB- previously Joan Cusumano -RRB- and Nancy Henderson on background vocals .	The Johnny Van Zant Band	The Johnny Van Zant Band	Van Zant	Van Zant	Joan Hecht	Joan Hecht	Nancy Henderson	Nancy Henderson
Van Zant released three more solo albums between 1981 and 1985 , before taking a break from the music business .	Van Zant	Van Zant
He became lead vocalist for the reunited Lynyrd Skynyrd in 1987 , and continues to record and perform with them today .	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Lynyrd Skynyrd

He released another solo album , Brickyard Road , in 1990 , which featured the popular title track , which was a # 1 hit on the U.S. Mainstream Rock Tracks chart for three weeks .	Brickyard Road	Brickyard Road	Mainstream Rock Tracks	Mainstream Rock Tracks
He also records and performs with his brother , Donnie , as Van Zant since 1998 .	Van Zant	Van Zant

In May 2006 , less than one day before he was to perform at KSAN-FM 107.7 The Bone 's Bone Bash 7 , Van Zant underwent emergency surgery to have his appendix removed .	Van Zant	Van Zant	KSAN-FM	KSAN-FM	appendix	Vermiform appendix
Treated at Stanford University Medical Center in Palo Alto , California , after reporting pain to a doctor earlier in the day .	Stanford University Medical Center	Stanford University Medical Center
The incident forced the band to cancel three U.S. shows .
Van Zant is a fan of the Jacksonville Jaguars .	Van Zant	Van Zant	Jacksonville Jaguars	Jacksonville Jaguars

He recorded a video , along with remaining members of Lynyrd Skynyrd , that is played at every Jaguars home game on the Everbank Field video board .	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Everbank Field	Everbank Field

According to Skynyrd 's website , Van Zant was again hospitalized on August 6 , 2011 at the Hennepin County Medical Center in Minneapolis , Minnesota due to complications from a previous surgery .	Van Zant	Van Zant	Hennepin County Medical Center	Hennepin County Medical Center
According to the website , Van Zant had a `` surgical site '' infected with cellulitus which required both hospitalization ad IV/Antibiotic Treatment .	Van Zant	Van Zant	cellulitus	cellulitus
He began displaying signs of a staph infection and other symptoms related to the infection .	staph infection	staph infection
His subsequent illness resulted in a number of scheduled performances being cancelled .
